allocatorReview: Both codecs preserve smaller-reservation retries and ultimately return false. Basis now explicitly returns false from growMemory; Draco now explicitly continues its retry loop after Memory.grow throws.
amdReview: AMD define calls are guarded by typeof define and the AMD marker, so absence of an AMD loader is intentional and safe.
upstreamPreservation: Upstream algorithm bodies and generated compatibility structure remain intact except for the documented small correctness/dead-code changes. Licensing, provenance, original UTF-8 and pre-existing working-tree changes were preserved.

codeChanges: Removed the redundant assignment of the Embind alias-check handle record to itself. Handle records are internal data properties and cloned records can be read-only.

Basis growMemory explicitly returns false on allocation failure instead of implicitly returning undefined; the enclosing allocator retains its retry and failure contract.
Draco explicitly continues to the next smaller memory reservation after allocation failure instead of relying on an empty catch and an undefined temporary.
